事先写好的判据 B（比不经过脑子高 ≥ 5 个点）与 D（换种子掉 ≤ 5 个点: Pre-registered criteria B (≥ 5 points above bypassing the brain) and D (drop ≤ 5 points when changing seed) hold. D only passed after training was changed three times: a single-seed 60 ms window dropped 32 points, 300 ms dropped 17, 3-seed averaging dropped 5.3, and noise augmentation brought it to 3.5, at the cost of about 3 points of agreement. This route works because line patterns can be **fully enumerated** — generalization to unseen line patterns is poor (holding out 20% of line patterns, shape recognition is only 0.72, open-four recall 0.02). The architectural ceiling (one free parameter per line pattern) is only 50.6%, and the teacher's own hand-written scores reach 56.2%
事先写好的判据 C（一致率高 ≥ 5 个点）与 C2（想 4 步正面交锋 ≥ 6: Pre-registered criteria C (agreement ≥ 5 points higher) and C2 (head-to-head thinking 4 moves ahead ≥ 60%) both fail. In this version both arms have the same readout dimensionality: the shuffled wiring has 14,069 active feature columns, of which 7,493 — as many as the real wiring — were taken at random. With equal dimensionality it still does not lose, so what can be said is "this brain is an adequate nonlinear expansion", not "the real wiring contributes something special to playing"
事先写好的判据 H2 不成立。与 §10 全脑上「嗅觉没有左右偏侧化」一致。只取: Pre-registered criterion H2 does not hold. This is consistent with §10's whole-brain finding that "olfaction has no left–right lateralization". Only two glomeruli were taken (taking all 1,850 ORNs would pull the antennal lobe and mushroom body into the sub-circuit). The only effect measured is modulation: vinegar odour lowers touch-evoked turning (DNa 6.0 → 0.7 Hz). "Attractive / aversive" are labels the literature gives these two glomeruli, not rules written into the model
事先写好的判据「用 8 步标签训练的模型 对 用 1 步标签训练的模型，200: The pre-registered criterion "model trained on 8-move labels vs model trained on 1-move labels, 200-game win rate ≥ 55%" **does not hold** (36.0%, draws counted as non-wins). The reason is the architectural ceiling: the readout can only give each line a value and add them up, and it cannot express the combinatorial reasoning that "looking ahead" needs. At the user's request the page defaults to pure model inference (reasoning steps = swapping the readout); alpha-beta is kept only as external search, off by default and labelled "algorithm, not fly"; handing the same table to a search thinking 6 moves ahead gives 31–9 against the teacher searching 4 — the gap comes entirely from the search
事先写死的换用判据是「新表对旧表 200 局胜率 ≥ 55%」。**第一次没过*: The switch criterion fixed in advance was "new table vs old table, 200-game win rate ≥ 55%". **The first attempt failed** (93–107, 46.5%): stage one's ridge coefficient was then fixed at 10 and fitted noise once dimensionality grew. Only after retraining with each arm choosing its own ridge coefficient on the other half of the training seeds did it give the result above — so this is the **second attempt**, and both are recorded here. A view = another random assignment table that hands the 24 channels to another set of input neurons; adding dimensions by splitting into time bins is a dead end (in-sample R² 0.976, across seeds 0.386). Against the teacher searching 6 moves, the old and new tables do not differ (32–28 vs 34–26); the gain is small
手选的旧值 4000 是它的 **202 倍**；标定后 LC4 从 0/200: The hand-picked old value 4000 was **202×** this; after calibration LC4 went from two values, 0/200, to 15 graded values
枢纽各自私有：CB0883 在水通路里根本不放电；CB0051 在糖通路里敲了没: Hubs are pathway-private: CB0883 does not fire at all in the water pathway; knocking out CB0051 in the sugar pathway has no effect (0.97 vs 0.49 in water)
双眼重叠 44.8°、总视野 297.2°、背后盲区 62.8°: Binocular overlap 44.8°, total field of view 297.2°, rear blind spot 62.8°
